records.source: It's full of empty beer bottles.
records.translation: Punô ito ng mga boteng walang laman.

records.source: Whoever lives here must really like a clean floor!
records.translation: Talagang gusto ng nakatira rito ang malinis na sahig!

records.source: It would probably be a bad idea to stick your tender arm in there.
records.translation: Malamang na masamang ideya ang ipasok doon ang malambot mong braso.

records.source: The bone is probably covered in bacteria. You decide not to touch it.
records.translation: Malamang na balot ng bakterya ang buto. Nagpasya kang huwag itong hawakan.

records.source: You uncork the bottle and waft the odor into your nostrils. The odor is surprisingly pleasant, with hints of apricot and spice berry.
records.translation: Tinanggal mo ang tapon ng bote at marahang pinaypayan ang singaw patungo sa ilong mo. Nakakagulat na kaaya-aya ang amoy, na may bahid ng aprikot at Mabangong Bunga.

records.source: Curse The Countryside!... A Spellbook For The Rural Witch
records.translation: Sumpain ang Kanayunan!... Isang Aklat ng Gayuma para sa Bruha sa Lalawigan

records.source: You try not to make eye contact...
records.translation: Sinusubukan mong huwag makipagtitigan...

records.source: Crane Man: Can't talk... I'm in the zone.
records.translation: Lalaki sa Crane: Hindi ako puwedeng makipag-usap... tutok ako.

records.source: The crane game is in use by someone else.
records.translation: May ibang gumagamit ng larong crane.

records.source: Crane Man: Almost... got it...
records.translation: Lalaki sa Crane: Malapit ko nang... makuha...

records.source: Welwick: Hmm, not many people here... and I invested a lot of money in this movie!
records.translation: Welwick: Hmm, kakaunti ang tao rito... at malaki ang ipinuhunan ko sa pelikulang ito!

records.source: Welwick: I foresee great things in your future... If you buy lots of tickets to this movie!
records.translation: Welwick: Nakikita ko ang magagandang bagay sa hinaharap mo... Kung bibili ka ng maraming tiket sa pelikulang ito!

records.source: Corner Guy: Brr... it's kind of drafty over here... I'm glad I wore my long pants!
records.translation: Lalaki sa Sulok: Brr... medyo mahangin dito... Mabuti na lang at nagsuot ako ng mahabang pantalon!

records.source: Corner Guy: Psst... I just saw the movie, and... Relax! I'm not going to spoil it for you.
records.translation: Lalaki sa Sulok: Psst... Napanood ko na ang pelikula, at... Kumalma ka! Hindi ko sisirain ang sorpresa para sa iyo.

records.source: Woman: Simon, don't you want something healthy? *sigh*... okay...
records.translation: Babae: Simon, ayaw mo ba ng masustansiya? *buntong-hininga*... sige...

records.source: Woman: How about some apple slices? No? *sigh*... okay...
records.translation: Babae: Gusto mo ng hiniwang mansanas? Ayaw? *buntong-hininga*... sige...

records.source: Simon: Mom! I want candy! *slurp*
records.translation: Simon: Ma! Gusto ko ng kendi! *slurp*

records.source: Simon: Mom! I want chocolate popcorn! *slurp*
records.translation: Simon: Ma! Gusto ko ng popcorn na tsokolate! *slurp*

records.source: Lupini: Amateurs! The set design was completely mundane!
records.translation: Lupini: Mga baguhan! Napakapangkaraniwan ng disenyo ng tagpuan!

records.source: Lupini: Amateurs! My nephew's 2nd birthday party home video had better cinematography!
records.translation: Lupini: Mga baguhan! Mas mahusay pa ang sinematograpiya ng pambahay na video ng ikalawang kaarawan ng pamangkin ko!

records.source: Moviegoer: Urgh... Too many snack options!
records.translation: Manonood: Urgh... Napakaraming mapagpipiliang meryenda!

records.source: Moviegoer: Ah, look at that popcorn go! Oh, the sounds... the smells!
records.translation: Manonood: Ah, tingnan mo kung paano pumuputok ang popcorn! O, ang mga tunog... ang mga amoy!

records.source: Woman: Get lost... I'm busy rubbing elbows with the Governor!
records.translation: Babae: Lumayas ka... Abala akong nakikisalamuha sa Gobernador!

records.source: Man: Uh oh... I think I'm a little overdressed for this place...
records.translation: Lalaki: Naku... Sa tingin ko ay masyado akong pormal para sa lugar na ito...

records.source: Man: I sat in the front row... big mistake.
records.translation: Lalaki: Umupo ako sa unahang hanay... malaking pagkakamali.

records.source: Governor: It's lovely to see economic development in the valley!
records.translation: Gobernador: Nakakatuwang makita ang pag-unlad ng ekonomiya sa lambak!

records.source: Governor: I really must bring the missus out for soup and a movie!
records.translation: Gobernador: Dapat ko talagang dalhin si misis para sa sopas at pelikula!

records.source: Hey, I'd love to chat, but I need to head back to the museum!
records.translation: Hoy, gusto kong makipagkuwentuhan, pero kailangan ko nang bumalik sa museo!

records.source: Hey, @. I just saw the movie, myself... not bad!
records.translation: Hoy, @. Napanood ko rin ang pelikula... hindi masama!

records.source: Gil slept through the whole movie... typical.
records.translation: Nakatulog si Gil sa buong pelikula... gaya ng dati.

records.source: That was an interesting one... what'd you think, Gil?#$b#...Gil?#$b#...He's out cold.
records.translation: Kawili-wili iyon... ano sa tingin mo, Gil?#$b#...Gil?#$b#...Tulog na tulog siya.

records.source: Marcello: What a spread! I think I'll go for the bourbon mayonnaise. Hehe!
records.translation: Marcello: Kay daming pagkain! Sa mayonesang bourbon yata ako. Hehe!

records.source: Marcello: What a spread! I think I'll go for the 12-grain spicy mustard. Hehe!
records.translation: Marcello: Kay daming pagkain! Sa maanghang na mustasa na may 12 uri ng butil yata ako. Hehe!

records.source: As you can see, the theater is a major success!$h#$b#Whaa...? A return on your investment? Well, it's difficult, you know... might take a while, you understand... *mumble*$2
records.translation: Gaya ng nakikita mo, napakalaking tagumpay ng sinehan!$h#$b#Anooo...? Tubo sa puhunan mo? Buweno, mahirap kasi, alam mo... baka matagalan, naiintindihan mo... *bulong*$2

records.source: Ah, it's our very important investment partner! Enjoy the show, and don't forget to buy a bag of JojaCorn on your way in!$h
records.translation: Ah, ang napakahalaga naming katuwang na mamumuhunan! Masiyahan ka sa palabas, at huwag kalimutang bumili ng isang supot ng JojaCorn sa pagpasok mo!$h

records.source: Play the Crane Game? (Costs {0}g)
records.translation: Maglaro ng Larong Crane? (Nagkakahalaga ng {0}g)

records.source: When dark clouds cry, begin your quest^To seek the fabled gem-birds four^Each day, one north, south, east, or west^Arrange their gifts upon my door
records.translation: Kapag umiyak ang maiitim na ulap, simulan ang pakay^Hanapin ang apat na maalamat na ibong-hiyas^Bawat araw, isa sa hilaga, timog, silangan, o kanluran^Ayusin ang mga handog nila sa harap ng aking pintuan

records.source: GREEN: You were always Momma's favorite! WaaaAaAa
records.translation: BERDE: Ikaw lagi ang paborito ni Mama! WaaaAaAa

records.source: RED: Mamma mia! Calm down, brother. Youch!
records.translation: PULA: Mamma mia! Kumalma ka, kapatid. Aray!

records.source: WELL-DRESSED PIRATE: *ahem*... Yar.#...#...Not convincing, huh?#*sigh*...#To tell you the truth, I don't really want to be a pirate. I'd rather grow palms.#Unfortunately, there's no money in the palm business...
records.translation: PIRATANG MAAYOS MANAMIT: *ahem*... Yar.#...#...Hindi kapani-paniwala, ano?#*buntong-hininga*...#Sa totoo lang, ayaw ko talagang maging pirata. Mas gusto kong magtanim ng mga palma.#Sa kasamaang-palad, walang pera sa negosyo ng palma...

records.source: BLACKGULL: Yar, matey. Ye must have a keen eye to've spotted our secret cove. Yo ho!
records.translation: BLACKGULL: Yar, kasama. Talas ng mata mo para makita ang lihim naming look. Yo ho!

records.source: GRIM PIRATE: From yonder seas, a chilling tale, a nightmare sure to haunt your sleep...#'Twas midnight when I lost me hands... to a savage monster o' the deep...#Yar, 'tis true...#...#...#..............#..............................................#Alright, I'm just kidding. I actually lost them while trying to fish an eggshell out of the blender.#Alas... me famous cake batter days are over...
records.translation: MALAGIM NA PIRATA: Mula sa malayong dagat, isang nakapangingilabot na kuwento, bangungot na tiyak na gugulo sa pagtulog mo...#Hatinggabi nang mawala ang mga kamay ko... sa mabangis na halimaw sa kailaliman...#Yar, totoo iyan...#...#...#..............#..............................................#Sige na nga, nagbibiro lang ako. Nawala talaga ang mga ito habang sinusubukan kong alisin ang balat ng itlog sa blender.#Sa kasamaang-palad... tapos na ang mga araw ko sa sikat kong masa ng keyk...

records.source: He's in a stupor...
records.translation: Parang wala siya sa sarili...

records.source: BARTENDER: Oi guv!... Grog and tasties are fer da pirates only.
records.translation: BARTENDER: Hoy!... Para lang sa mga pirata ang alak at masasarap na pagkain.

records.source: DART MAN: Care for a game o' darts? You've got 20 darts to score exactly 301 points.
records.translation: LALAKI SA DART: Gusto mong maglaro ng dart? Mayroon kang 20 dart para makakuha ng eksaktong 301 puntos.

records.source: DART MAN: How about we make things more interesting. Hit exactly 301 points within 15 darts and I'll be impressed, matey!
records.translation: LALAKI SA DART: Gawin nating mas kawili-wili. Makakuha ka ng eksaktong 301 puntos gamit ang 15 dart at hahanga ako, kasama!

records.source: DART MAN: Ah, good to see ya again, matey! Let's see if you can score 301 points within... 10 darts!
records.translation: LALAKI SA DART: Ah, mabuti at nakita kitang muli, kasama! Tingnan natin kung makakakuha ka ng 301 puntos gamit ang... 10 dart!

records.source: DART MAN: Ahoy! If it isn't me matey... ol' steady-hands! How about a game o' darts for old times' sake?
records.translation: LALAKI SA DART: Ahoy! Aba, kung hindi ang kasama kong... si Matatag-ang-Kamay! Gusto mong maglaro ng dart gaya noong araw?

records.source: DART MAN: Well, shiver me timbers! That's a perfect game!
records.translation: LALAKI SA DART: Aba, yanigin ang mga troso ko! Perpektong laro iyon!

records.source: DART MAN: Well, sink me! That's some good throwing!
records.translation: LALAKI SA DART: Aba, palubugin ako! Ang husay mong bumato!

records.source: Here's a little something for ya.
records.translation: Heto ang munting regalo para sa iyo.

records.source: Come back again any time!
records.translation: Bumalik ka anumang oras!

records.source: DART MAN: Yar... Better luck next time...
records.translation: LALAKI SA DART: Yar... Bawi ka na lang sa susunod...

records.source: BARTENDER: Oi! I never seen the likes o' you, before. But if ye got the pirate look, then 'ave one on me! Har Har!
records.translation: BARTENDER: Hoy! Ngayon lang ako nakakita ng tulad mo. Pero kung mukha kang pirata, libre ka sa akin! Har Har!

records.source: BARTENDER: Back fer more, eh? Har Har! You've had enough, matey...
records.translation: BARTENDER: Babalik ka pa, ha? Har Har! Tama na ang nainom mo, kasama...
